lines.zh: 轮子碾过石缝，咔嗒咔嗒。
lines.en: Wheels grinding through stone cracks, click-clack.

lines.zh: 地底走廊真适合滚动前进。
lines.en: These underground halls are perfect for rolling.
The echoes follow me round and round.
Drill forward—nobody block the way.

lines.zh: 黑暗里我的轮轴转得最欢。
lines.en: My axle spins merriest in the dark.
Gravel crackles beneath my wheels.
Rolling on down the mine shaft.
My wheel squeaks on the turn.
The smell of dirt grows stronger.

lines.zh: 轮辐带起的风扫过脚边。
lines.en: The wind from my spokes sweeps past.

lines.zh: 滴水的洞顶，我照滚不误。
lines.en: Dripping ceiling—I roll on anyway.

lines.zh: 前方有岔路，随便挑一条。
lines.en: A fork ahead—I'll pick one.

lines.zh: 轮子停下，轴还在微微颤。
lines.en: Wheels stopped, axle still quivering.
Resting against the rock for a bit.

lines.zh: 地下安静得只剩滴水声。
lines.en: So quiet down here, just dripping water.
Mud clings to my spokes.
Who dulled my drill?

lines.zh: 黑暗中待着，轮轴慢慢转。
lines.en: Waiting in the dark, axle slowly turning.

lines.zh: 这层岩壁挺结实，靠得住。
lines.en: This wall is solid enough to lean on.

lines.zh: 听听远处有没有脚步声。
lines.en: Listening for footsteps far away.
Wheels not spinning—feels wrong.
The underground air is chilly.
You stepped into my tunnel.

lines.zh: 两脚走路的，转得比我慢。
lines.en: Two-legged one, you turn slower than me.
Hold still, let me see those feet.
Did you fall from above?
My drill is pointed right at you.

lines.zh: 地底可不欢迎随便乱逛。
lines.en: The depths don't welcome wanderers.
You carry the smell of the surface.

lines.zh: 轮子转起来可比你腿快。
lines.en: My wheels spin faster than your legs.
Don't back up—there's rock behind you.
I've got my eye on you—no slipping past.
Axle jolts—who hit me?
The drill nearly got knocked crooked.
Pain made my wheels slip.

lines.zh: 轮辐颤了一下，我记下了。
lines.en: Spokes shivered—I'll remember that.
I need a few rolls to shake this off.
You hit my wheel.

lines.zh: 四十点的底子还扛得住。
lines.en: Forty points of health can take it.
My wheels are rolling a bit crooked.
Not another hit—the axle will loosen.
Fighting down here always hurts.

lines.zh: 食物？我轮子底下只有石头。
lines.en: Food? There's only stone under my wheels.

lines.zh: 别拿吃的晃我，我不靠嘴。
lines.en: Don't wave food at me—I don't eat with a mouth.

lines.zh: 钻石倒是会让我多转两圈。
lines.en: Diamonds would make me spin an extra turn or two.

lines.zh: 你手里那玩意儿能滚吗？
lines.en: Can that thing in your hand roll?
Smells nice, but useless to me.

lines.zh: 我想要的掉落物你给不了。
lines.en: You can't give me the drop I want.

lines.zh: 把吃的收起来，别挡我轮子。
lines.en: Put the food away—don't block my wheels.
A depths creature doesn't crave your bite.

lines.zh: 轮子只对硬东西感兴趣。
lines.en: My wheels only care about hard things.

lines.zh: 你晃来晃去，我有点想撞。
lines.en: You keep swaying—I kind of want to ram.
Clang! My wheels hit you.

lines.zh: 让开，你挡了我的滚动线。
lines.en: Move—you're in my rolling line.

lines.zh: 撞一下，钻头顺便蹭到你。
lines.en: One bump, and my drill grazes you too.
I crack stone—you're no problem.
Wheels slipped—hit you off-center.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，轮辐会刮人。
lines.en: Don't get so close—spokes scrape.
Your legs buckled—I didn't stop.

lines.zh: 这一撞算打招呼还是警告？
lines.en: Is this bump a greeting or a warning?
Narrow tunnels—collisions happen.

lines.zh: 轮子反弹回来，再来一次。
lines.en: Wheels bounced back—here's another.
Wheel to wheel? Not a thing.

lines.zh: 我只管转和撞，不谈这个。
lines.en: I only spin and ram—not this.

lines.zh: 地底没有我的同类要凑对。
lines.en: No kin down here to pair with.
My drill isn't sharpened for that.
Axles spin alone, independently.
Wrong creature—go away.

lines.zh: 繁殖不在我的轮子清单上。
lines.en: Breeding isn't on my wheel list.
Don't come closer—I just want to roll.

lines.zh: 两个轮子撞一起只会卡住。
lines.en: Two wheels colliding only jam.

lines.zh: 这事跟我一点关系都没有。
lines.en: This has nothing to do with me.

lines.zh: 地上亮晶晶的，滚过去看看。
lines.en: Something shiny on the ground—roll over and see.

lines.zh: 钻石？轮子底下捡到就是我的。
lines.en: Diamond? Under my wheels means it's mine.

lines.zh: 这块石头有点分量，收着。
lines.en: This stone has weight—keep it.
Spokes clamp it—won't drop it.

lines.zh: 捡东西的时候轮轴有点晃。
lines.en: Axle wobbles a bit while picking up.
Dropped in the tunnel—nobody grab it.

lines.zh: 小东西，滚进我的轮缝里。
lines.en: Little thing, roll into my wheel gap.

lines.zh: 我的钻头旁边可不适合放杂物。
lines.en: Debris doesn't belong beside my drill.
Pick it up, roll on my way.

lines.zh: 这层地底的掉落物归我管。
lines.en: Depths drops are my business.
Movement underfoot—locked on.
Drill aimed at you—hold still.
Heard footsteps—target spotted.
An intruder down here—got them.

lines.zh: 两脚走路的，你被盯上了。
lines.en: Two-legged one, you're marked.

lines.zh: 轮子开始加速，目标在前面。
lines.en: Wheels speeding up—target ahead.
Locking onto the one that breathes.

lines.zh: 地面上的气味，跑不掉了。
lines.en: Surface scent—no escape now.

lines.zh: 我的轮子已经对准方向。
lines.en: My wheels are already aimed.
Target confirmed—drill warming up.
Just you in this cave—easy choice.

lines.zh: 找到你了，别躲石头后面。
lines.en: Found you—don't hide behind that rock.
Axle tightens—ready to chase.
Lock complete—rolling out.
That shadow—that's you.
Depths hunter is in position.

lines.zh: 轮子跟着你转，别想甩开。
lines.en: My wheels follow you—can't shake me.

lines.zh: 你往左，我滚左；往右，我滚右。
lines.en: You go left, I roll left; right, right.

lines.zh: 钻头一直对着你的方向。
lines.en: The drill stays pointed your way.

lines.zh: 脚步声骗不了我的轮轴。
lines.en: Footsteps can't fool my axle.
I spin through the soil toward you.

lines.zh: 岩壁挡不住滚动的追踪。
lines.en: Rock walls don't stop a rolling pursuit.

lines.zh: 距离在缩短，轮子越转越快。
lines.en: Distance shrinking—wheels spinning faster.

lines.zh: 别回头，我就贴在你身后。
lines.en: Don't look back—I'm right behind you.

lines.zh: 拐弯也没用，轮子跟得紧。
lines.en: Turns won't help—my wheels follow close.

lines.zh: 你的脚印在地上，藏不住。
lines.en: Your footprints stay on the ground.

lines.zh: 轮辐指着的方向就是你。
lines.en: Where my spokes point is you.

lines.zh: 地底再黑，我也能追到你。
lines.en: However dark—I'll still track you.
Run fast if you like—wheels are steadier.

lines.zh: 锁定了就不松，轮子说了算。
lines.en: Locked on for good—wheels decide.
The drill is ready to lunge.

lines.zh: 我绕近路，你别高兴太早。
lines.en: I'll take the shortcut—don't celebrate yet.

lines.zh: 轮子碾过碎石，声音就是你。
lines.en: Wheels crunch gravel—that sound is you.

lines.zh: 别想爬上去，我守在下面。
lines.en: Don't try climbing—I guard below.
Wheels won't stop until I reach you.

lines.zh: 你被轮子锁定，跑也是白跑。
lines.en: Wheel-locked—running is pointless.

lines.zh: 钻头扎进去，轮子还在转。
lines.en: Drill goes in—wheels keep spinning.
One ram, one drill—that's your lot.
Spokes sweep across your legs.
Six points of damage—just enough pain.
Don't just stand there—roll away.
The drill bites into an armor gap.
Wheels grind over your instep.
Ram in, then add a drill.
You step back one—I roll two.
Axle drives, drill thrusts forward.
Down here, wheels have the edge.

lines.zh: 这一下是给你踩矿道的教训。
lines.en: That's for trampling my tunnel.
The drill spins faster than you dodge.
My wheel caught your ankle.
Covering up won't help you.

lines.zh: 再来一钻，往同一个地方。
lines.en: Another drill—same spot.
Wheels knock your guard open.

lines.zh: 岩壁回声里全是钻头声。
lines.en: Drill noise fills the echoing rock.
My shell spins like a saw.
Wheels pull back half—drill pushes in.

lines.zh: 轮子从岩缝里滚出来了。
lines.en: Wheels roll out of a rock crevice.
Deep underground, the axle starts to turn.

lines.zh: 黑暗里亮起轮辐的影子。
lines.en: Spoke shadows rise in the dark.
I squeeze out between the stones.
This tunnel is mine to roll.
Drill sharpened, wheels in place.

lines.zh: 上面掉下来的光，照不到我。
lines.en: Light from above doesn't reach me.

lines.zh: 地底多了个转动的家伙。
lines.en: The depths gained a spinning fellow.
Wheels crush the first gravel.
Just rolled out—axle still hot.
Dripping water now has wheel noise.
I'm waiting on this level.

lines.zh: 火烧得轮子发烫，我讨厌火。
lines.en: Fire heats my wheels—I hate it.
Fell hard—axle nearly snapped.
Water floods my axle—can't spin.
The blast flung my wheels up.

lines.zh: 什么东西射中我的轮辐！
lines.en: Something struck my spokes!
That spell made my axle go numb.
Hungry? My wheels don't eat.
Lightning struck—my wheels went numb.
Nothing below—wheels falling into the void.
